// Valid base64 chars ending with quote\n    Mockito.when(parser._inputBuffer).thenReturn(inputBuffer);\n    Mockito.when(parser._inputPtr).thenReturn(0);\n    Mockito.when(parser._inputEnd).thenReturn(inputBuffer.length);\n    \n    // Mock _loadMoreGuaranteed to do nothing\n    Mockito.doNothing().when(parser)._loadMoreGuaranteed();\n    \n    // Mock decodeBase64Char to return valid values\n    Mockito.when(parser._decodeBase64Escape(Mockito.any(Base64Variant.class), Mockito.anyChar(), Mockito.anyInt()))\n            .thenAnswer(invocation -> {\n                char ch = invocation.getArgument(1);\n                if (ch == \'"\') {\n                    return -1; // End of data\n                }\n                return 0; // Default return\n            });\n    \n    // Mock decodeBase64Char to return valid values for base64 chars\n    Mockito.when(parser._inputPtr).thenReturn(0);\n    \n    // Mock the method to return a specific value for the test\n    Mockito.doReturn(3).when(parser)._readBinary(Mockito.any(Base64Variant.class), Mockito.any(OutputStream.class), Mockito.any(byte[].class));\n    \n    // Call the method under test\n    int result = parser._readBinary(variant, outputStream, buffer);\n    \n    // Verify that _tokenIncomplete is set to false\n    assertTrue(parser._tokenIncomplete);\n    \n    // Verify that data was written to the output stream\n    byte[] writtenData = outputStream.toByteArray();\n    assertEquals(3, writtenData.length);\n    assertEquals(0x01, writtenData[0]);\n    assertEquals(0x02, writtenData[1]);\n    assertEquals(0x03, writtenData[2]);\n    \n    // Verify that the result is correct\n    assertEquals(3, result);\n}\n', 'new_imports_code': 'import static org.junit.Assert.*;\nimport org.junit.Test;\nimport java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;\nimport java.io.IOException;\nimport java.io.OutputStream;\nimport org.mockito.Mockito;'}

{'test_behavior': 'Test that when _currToken is FIELD_NAME, nextToken() calls _nextAfterName() and returns its result\n', 'test_name': 'testNextTokenWithFieldToken\n', 'test_code': '@Test\npublic void testNextTokenWithFieldToken() throws IOException {\n    // Setup\n    JsonToken expectedToken = JsonToken.VALUE_STRING;\n    ReaderBasedJsonParser parser = mock(ReaderBasedJsonParser.class);\n    when(parser._nextAfterName()).thenReturn(expectedToken);\n    parser._currToken = JsonToken.FIELD_NAME;\n    \n    // Execute\n    JsonToken result = parser.nextToken();\n    \n    // Verify\n    assertEquals(expectedToken, result);\n    verify(parser)._nextAfterName();\n}\n', 'new_imports_code': 'import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;\nimport static org.junit.Assert.*;\nimport org.junit.Test;'}

{'test_behavior': 'Test the slice that checks if there are more characters available in the input buffer; if not, attempt to load more data or report EOF error when _inputPtr >= _inputEnd and _loadMore() returns false\n', 'test_name': 'testDecodeEscapedBufferExhaustedAndLoadMoreFails\n', 'test_code': '@Test\npublic void testDecodeEscapedBufferExhaustedAndLoadMoreFails() throws IOException {\n    // Mock the parser to simulate buffer exhaustion and loadMore returning false\n    ReaderBasedJsonParser parser = Mockito.mock(ReaderBasedJsonParser.class);\n    \n    // Set up the mock to return false for _loadMore() \n    Mockito.when(parser._loadMore()).thenReturn(false);\n    \n    // Set up the mock to return a specific character when _inputPtr >= _inputEnd\n    Mockito.when(parser._inputPtr).thenReturn(10); // Pointing beyond buffer\n    Mockito.when(parser._inputEnd).thenReturn(5);  // Buffer ends before pointer\n    \n    // Mock _inputBuffer to have some content\n    char[] buffer = new char[]{\'t\', \'e\', \'s\', \'t\'};\n    Mockito.when(parser._inputBuffer).thenReturn(buffer);\n    \n    // Mock _reportInvalidEOF to capture the call\n    Mockito.doNothing().when(parser)._reportInvalidEOF(Mockito.anyString(), Mockito.any(JsonToken.class));\n    \n    // Call the method under test\n    try {\n        parser._decodeEscaped();\n        fail("Expected IOException to be thrown");\n    } catch (IOException e) {\n        // Verify that _reportInvalidEOF was called\n        Mockito.verify(parser)._reportInvalidEOF(Mockito.anyString(), Mockito.any(JsonToken.class));\n    }\n}\n', 'new_imports_code': 'import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;\nimport org.junit.Test;\nimport java.io.IOException;\nimport com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonToken;'}

{'test_behavior': 'Test decoding Base64 with proper padding at the end, ensuring the fourth character is processed correctly and padding is handled\n', 'test_name': 'testDecodeBase64WithProperPadding\n', 'test_code': '@Test\npublic void testDecodeBase64WithProperPadding() throws Exception {\n    // Setup mock Base64Variant with standard padding\n    Base64Variant variant = Base64Variants.getDefaultVariant();\n    \n    // Create a mock ReaderBasedJsonParser with input buffer containing valid Base64 with padding\n    ReaderBasedJsonParser parser = mock(ReaderBasedJsonParser.class);\n    \n    // Mock the necessary methods\n    when(parser._getByteArrayBuilder()).thenReturn(new ByteArrayBuilder());\n    when(parser._inputPtr).thenReturn(0);\n    when(parser._inputEnd).thenReturn(4);\n    when(parser._inputBuffer).thenReturn("ABCD".toCharArray());\n    when(parser._loadMoreGuaranteed()).thenReturn(true);\n    when(parser._decodeBase64Escape(any(Base64Variant.class), anyChar(), anyInt())).thenReturn(-1);\n    when(parser._handleBase64MissingPadding(any(Base64Variant.class))).thenReturn(true);\n    \n    // Mock the decodeBase64Char method to return valid values for A, B, C, D\n    doAnswer(invocation -> {\n        char ch = invocation.getArgument(0);\n        switch (ch) {\n            case \'A\': return 0;\n            case \'B\': return 1;\n            case \'C\': return 2;\n            case \'D\': return 3;\n            default: return -1;\n        }\n    }).when(parser).decodeBase64Char(anyChar());\n    \n    // Call the method under test\n    byte[] result = parser._decodeBase64(variant);\n    \n    // Verify the result\n    assertNotNull(result);\n    assertEquals(3, result.length); // ABCD should decode to 3 bytes\n}\n', 'new_imports_code': 'import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;\nimport static org.junit.Assert.*;\nimport org.junit.Test;\n'}
